mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a vital part of assessing the value of employee and management activities."
Measuring performance is a vital part of assessing the value of employee and management activities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means setting standards, measuring performance and taking appropriate action."
Monitoring means setting standards, measuring performance and taking appropriate action.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the knowledge, skills and behaviours required to produce the expected results."
The inputs are the knowledge, skills and behaviours required to produce the expected results.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the behavioural observation scale (or BOS)."
A recent variation on BARS is the behavioural observation scale (or BOS).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a result that can be measured quantifiably, while an outcome is a visible effect that is the result of effort but cannot necessarily be measured in quantified terms."
Outputs and outcomes An output is a result that can be measured quantifiably, while an outcome is a visible effect that is the result of effort but cannot necessarily be measured in quantified terms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the degree of accomplishment of the tasks that make up an employee s job."
Performance refers to the degree of accomplishment of the tasks that make up an employee s job.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with outputs (the achievement of results) and outcomes (the impact made on performance)."
Programme execution Performance management is concerned with outputs (the achievement of results) and outcomes (the impact made on performance).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the net effect of an employee s effort as modified by abilities and role (or task) perceptions."
Determinants of Performance Job performance is the net effect of an employee s effort as modified by abilities and role (or task) perceptions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the key instrument for the implementation of the medium term plans or rolling plans."
The Budget Framework The annual budget is the key instrument for the implementation of the medium term plans or rolling plans.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an acronym for specific, measurable, attainable, results- oriented and timebound."
SMART is an acronym for specific, measurable, attainable, results- oriented and timebound.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the continuing assessment of an individual's performance by his manager in the normal course of work."
Informal appraisal is the continuing assessment of an individual's performance by his manager in the normal course of work.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a cycle, with discussions varying year-to-year based on changing objectives."
The Performance Management process is a cycle, with discussions varying year-to-year based on changing objectives.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the pattern of shared beliefs, norms and values in an organisation that shape the way people act and interact and strongly influence the ways in which things get done."
Organisational culture is the pattern of shared beliefs, norms and values in an organisation that shape the way people act and interact and strongly influence the ways in which things get done.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to accuracy, appearance, usefulness or effectiveness."
Quality refers to accuracy, appearance, usefulness or effectiveness.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the strength of a person's belief about whether or not a particular job performance is attainable."
Expectancy refers to the strength of a person's belief about whether or not a particular job performance is attainable.
